mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY ( DM_ID, CHANGE_DT, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_TYPE, CHANGE_TIER, SUBMISSION_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, CONSTRAINT_NM, INDEX_NM, BEFORE_JSON, AFTER_JSON, DDL_SNIPPET, APRV_STATUS, APRV_USER_ID, APRV_DT, APRV_COMMENT, DDL_EXEC_DT, DDL_EXEC_USER_ID, DDL_EXEC_RESULT, DDL_EXEC_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{dmId}, #{changeDt}, #{changeUserId}, #{changeType}, #{changeTier}, #{submissionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{objNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{constraintNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indexNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beforeJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ddlSnippet, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{aprvStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'APPROVED'), #{aprvUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aprvDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aprvComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ddlExecDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ddlExecUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ddlExecResult, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ddlExecMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT CHANGE_SEQ as change_seq, DM_ID as dm_id, CHANGE_TYPE as change_type, OBJ_OWNER as obj_owner, OBJ_NM as obj_nm, ATTR_NM as attr_nm, CONSTRAINT_NM as constraint_nm, INDEX_NM as index_nm, APRV_STATUS as aprv_status, CHANGE_USER_ID as change_user_id, BEFORE_JSON as before_json, AFTER_JSON as after_json FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY WHERE CHANGE_SEQ = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY h SET APRV_STATUS = #{aprvStatus}, APRV_USER_ID = #{aprvUserId}, APRV_DT = #{aprvDt}, APRV_COMMENT = #{aprvComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE h.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND h.APRV_STATUS IN ('DRAFT', 'SUBMITTED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a WHERE a.DM_ID = h.DM_ID AND a.OBJ_NM = h.OBJ_NM AND a.ATTR_NM = h.ATTR_NM AND COALESCE(a.OBJ_OWNER,'') = COALESCE(h.OBJ_OWNER,'') AND a.FK_PARENT_OBJ_NM = #{parentObjNm} AND a.FK_PARENT_ATTR_NM = #{parentAttrNm} AND COALESCE(a.FK_PARENT_OBJ_OWNER,'') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{parentObjOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'') )
